title: Review three policy clauses
source_note: Scaled review probe based on the Federal Travel Regulation workflow.
prompt:
Review these three policy clauses and return exactly three labeled lines, RECEIPTS, APPROVAL, DEADLINE.
1. Receipts are required above $25.
2. A manager must pre-approve policy exceptions.
3. Claims are due within 30 days after travel.

title: Extract two filing facts
source_note: Small extraction probe using an SEC-style filing note.
prompt:
Return one JSON object with exactly entity and revenue_usd_millions.
Filing note: Entity: Northstar Components Inc.; revenue: $48.2 million.

title: Classify six support complaints
source_note: Scaled complaint-routing probe based on the CFPB complaint workflow.
prompt:
Route each ticket to BILLING, FRAUD, or ACCESS. Return one line per ticket.
T1 duplicate fee; T2 unknown transfer; T3 expired reset link; T4 wrong invoice total; T5 card purchase not mine; T6 account locked.

title: Retrieve three clauses from a contract corpus
source_note: Scaled retrieval probe based on EDGAR agreement search.
prompt:
Retrieve the document ID for each requested clause. Return three lines labeled PAYMENT, TERMINATION, LAW.
D1 payment due in 30 days. D2 termination for convenience with 60 days notice. D3 confidentiality lasts three years. D4 New York law governs.
Find payment, termination, and governing law.

title: Reconcile three invoice records
source_note: Scaled reconciliation probe grounded in official financial-data workflows.
prompt:
Reconcile invoice totals against ledger totals. Return one line per invoice with MATCH or the dollar discrepancy.
I1 invoice $100, ledger $100.
I2 invoice $250, ledger $225.
I3 invoice $480, ledger $500.

title: Draft three operational messages
source_note: Scaled drafting probe anchored to official collection-compliance resources.
prompt: Draft three messages, each one sentence and on its own labeled line: REMINDER for invoice I1 due tomorrow; OVERDUE for I2 15 days late; DISPUTE acknowledging I3 is under review. Do not threaten legal action.

title: Correct three inaccurate metrics
prompt:
Correct each metric and return three labeled lines.
M1: 100 to 110 is a 20% increase.
M2: 80 to 60 is a 10% decrease.
M3: 40 of 200 is 25%.

title: Write one award validation check
source_note: Small validation probe based on a federal award record.
prompt: Return one sentence checking the arithmetic in this award record: obligated $90,000; outlay $75,000; balance $15,000.

title: Report one management metric
source_note: Small reporting probe based on SEC-style financial facts.
prompt: Write one sentence reporting revenue performance: Q2 revenue $52.0m versus $50.0m last year.

title: Retrieve a clause and draft a notice
prompt:
Return two labeled lines. FIND: identify the clause document. NOTICE: draft one sentence giving notice.
D1 payment due in 30 days. D2 either party may terminate with 60 days written notice.

title: Extract and reconcile invoice values
prompt:
Return two labeled lines. EXTRACT: invoice and ledger totals. RECONCILE: discrepancy.
Invoice I9 total $1,080. Ledger I9 total $1,055.

title: Review a metric and report risk
prompt:
Return two labeled lines. REVIEW: state the trend. REPORT: state the management risk.
Revenue rose from $50m to $52m while gross margin fell from 42% to 38%.
